name: context-toolkit
description: Workflow skills (a-plus-plus goal compiler, tdd-workflow, rust-testing, santa-method, config-gc) plus the context layer they assume: terse caveman output style, rtk bash-output filtering, code-review-graph incremental review graph, per-session reading/command/turn rules, a symbol outline instead of whole-file Reads over 20 KB, and a UI Automation helper that replaces screenshots on Windows. Run /context-toolkit:setup after install, then /context-toolkit:verify.
